Video Testimonials: How to Get and Use Them Effectively

Nothing sells like a happy customer. Here's how to collect video testimonials that move the needle.

Why Video Testimonials Work

Text testimonials are easy to fake. Video testimonials carry authenticity that text can't match—real people, real emotions, real endorsements. They trigger mirror neurons: when we see someone excited, we feel it too.

The data: 92% of buyers read reviews before purchasing. Video testimonials are 2x more trusted than text.

When to Ask for Testimonials

  • After a win: Customer just hit a milestone
  • After positive support: You solved their problem
  • At renewal: They're committing again
  • NPS 9-10: Prime testimonial candidates

The 5 Essential Questions

1. The "Before"

"What was your situation before using [Product]?"

2. The Decision

"What made you choose [Product]?"

3. The Results

"What specific results have you seen?"

4. The Feature

"Which feature has been most valuable?"

5. The Recommendation

"What would you tell someone considering [Product]?"

Recording Options

Method Best For Cost
Self-recorded (Loom) Scale, authenticity Free
Remote interview (Zoom) Guided conversation Low
On-site production Flagship customers High

Where to Use Testimonials

Placement Format Impact
Homepage 60-90 sec supercut Immediate trust
Pricing page Results clips Overcome objections
Sales emails 15-30 sec clips Break through inbox
Social media Square/vertical Social proof in feed
Ads 15-30 sec Highest trust ad format

Editing for Impact

  • Hook first: Best quote upfront
  • Keep it short: 60-90 seconds ideal
  • Add captions: 80%+ watch muted
  • Include stats: Numbers build credibility
